battle.abilities.smoke_bomb.name: Smoke Bomb
battle.abilities.smoke_bomb.description: Throw it over your warriors as they walk into a defense's range. For 8 seconds, warriors inside the cloud can only be shot from close up (Night Blades also hit buildings inside it twice as hard).
buildings.elder_toadstool.name: Clan Keep
buildings.elder_toadstool.description: The hidden heart of your clan. Upgrade it to unlock new buildings, warriors and higher levels.
buildings.acorn_orchard.name: Coin Mint
buildings.acorn_orchard.description: Artisans stamp fresh Coins every hour. Holds 8 hours of output, so collect often.
buildings.dewdrop_well.name: Terraced Farm
buildings.dewdrop_well.description: Terraced fields that grow Provisions for your warriors. Holds 8 hours of output.
buildings.acorn_silo.name: Treasury
buildings.acorn_silo.description: A locked vault for your Coins. Bigger treasuries let you save for bigger upgrades.
buildings.dew_cistern.name: Provision Storehouse
buildings.dew_cistern.description: Stores Provisions for your warriors. Raiders can only carry off part of what is inside.
buildings.beaver_lodge.name: Artisan's Hut
buildings.beaver_lodge.description: Home of a Village Artisan. Each hut lets you build or upgrade one thing at a time.
buildings.burrow_barracks.name: Training Dojo
buildings.burrow_barracks.description: Trains warriors and studies battle scrolls to make them stronger. Higher levels unlock new warriors.
buildings.army_camp.name: Squad Courtyard
buildings.army_camp.description: Where trained warriors wait for the next raid. Each level houses more.
buildings.acorn_cannon.name: Kunai Tower
buildings.acorn_cannon.description: A lookout that throws volleys of kunai at warriors on the ground. Cannot hit flyers.
buildings.pinecone_catapult.name: Firework Mortar
buildings.pinecone_catapult.description: Launches bursting fireworks that splash groups of warriors on the ground. Slow, and blind to warriors right beside it.
buildings.wasp_nest.name: Shuriken Tower
buildings.wasp_nest.description: Spinning shuriken strike warriors on the ground and in the air.
buildings.firefly_tower.name: Sky Bow Tower
buildings.firefly_tower.description: Archers with great bows that hit flying warriors hard. Ignores warriors on the ground.
buildings.bramble_hedge.name: Stone Wall
buildings.bramble_hedge.description: Fitted mountain stone. Warriors walk around it or break through it. Higher levels add iron-banded gates. Builds instantly.
buildings.thorn_snare.name: Spike Pit
buildings.thorn_snare.description: A hidden pit of bamboo spikes that springs when warriors on the ground step close. Unseen until it goes off.
buildings.sap_puddle.name: Caltrop Field
buildings.sap_puddle.description: Hidden iron caltrops that slow warriors on the ground to half speed for a few seconds.
buildings.flower_bed.name: Bonsai Planter
buildings.flower_bed.description: A carefully shaped little pine. Purely decorative.
buildings.lantern_post.name: Stone Lantern
buildings.lantern_post.description: A carved stone lantern that glows through the night. Purely decorative.
buildings.mushroom_ring.name: Rock Garden
buildings.mushroom_ring.description: Raked gravel and three quiet stones. Purely decorative.
buildings.mossy_statue.name: Stone Sentinel Statue
buildings.mossy_statue.description: A weathered stone sentinel that watches the gate. Purely decorative.
buildings.obstacle_bush.name: Bamboo Thicket
buildings.obstacle_bush.description: Clear it to make room. You might find Jade!
buildings.obstacle_stump.name: Fallen Cedar
buildings.obstacle_stump.description: Clear it to make room. You might find Jade!
buildings.obstacle_rock.name: Mountain Boulder
buildings.obstacle_rock.description: Clear it to make room. You might find Jade!
buildings.grove_lodge.name: Alliance Lodge
buildings.grove_lodge.description: Your link to your Alliance. Holds the warriors your allies send you, ready for your next raid.
buildings.paper_lantern_line.name: Paper Lantern Line
buildings.paper_lantern_line.description: Lanterns strung low between posts. Hidden or mist-veiled ground warriors within 2 tiles are lit up for a few seconds: defenses can see them, and lit warriors take extra damage. Once it has lit someone, the line itself is no longer hidden.
buildings.clockwork_repairer.name: Clockwork Repair Crane
buildings.clockwork_repairer.description: A mechanic's crane that reaches over nearby defenses: jams, stuns and a Hawk Tamer's slowing on defenses within 3 tiles are cut short. A few repairs per battle.
buildings.bitter_incense_burner.name: Bitter Smoke Brazier
buildings.bitter_incense_burner.descript: Burns bitter herbs: warriors within 3 tiles receive less healing, and healing, haste and toughness auras and shelter shields work at reduced strength on them.
buildings.kite_cutter_ballista.name: Kite-Cutter Ballista
buildings.kite_cutter_ballista.descripti: Air only. Fires a spinning bolas that tangles anything with wings or strings: a flyer it hits is grounded for 3 seconds, where ground defenses can reach it. A flyer that breaks free can't be tangled again for 3 seconds.
buildings.longbow_yagura.name: Longbow Yagura
buildings.longbow_yagura.description: A tall archery tower with range 13 that outranges every siege warrior. It prefers warriors attacking from 3.5 tiles or more (throwers and artillery), but cannot hit anything closer than 2 tiles.

progression.roles.saboteur.summary: Specialist that disables defenses for a short time.

progression.roles.infiltrator.summary: Gets past walls by tunnel, rope or rooftop.
progression.roles.sky.name: Sky

progression.roles.mystic.name: Mystic

progression.buildingCatalog.scroll_libra: Moves warrior research out of the Training Dojo and studies mastery scrolls.
progression.buildingCatalog.shadow_ink_w: Distils Shadow Ink, the third currency, used for Veteran-tier warriors and heroes.
progression.buildingCatalog.reinforced_g: A wall segment with an iron-banded gate; tougher than stone and opens only for defenders.
progression.buildingCatalog.sky_net.name: Sky Net
progression.buildingCatalog.sky_net.desc: Hidden net that snares flyers for a few seconds.
Home of a clan hero; one hall per hero.
progression.buildingCatalog.temple_bell_: Rings when warriors approach: reveals Shadow warriors and halves smoke duration nearby.
progression.buildingCatalog.clan_forge.d: Forges equipment that adds small bonuses to one role at a time.
progression.buildingCatalog.wind_chime_w: Tripwire that slows and reveals everything that crosses it.
progression.buildingCatalog.crossbow_bas: Fires at three targets at once.
progression.buildingCatalog.flame_trench: A trench that bursts into flame under warriors on the ground.
progression.buildingCatalog.thunder_shri: Chain lightning that jumps between flyers.
progression.buildingCatalog.ninja_watch_: Sends out defending ninja who chase attackers.
progression.buildingCatalog.great_dragon: The keep's last word: enormous damage, very slow.
progression.buildingCatalog.whirling_bla: Short-range spinning blades hit every ground warrior within 1.2 tiles. Punishes cheap melee swarms; useless against anything that stands back.
progression.buildingCatalog.paper_lanter: Lanterns strung low between posts. Hidden or mist-veiled ground warriors within 2 tiles are lit up for a few seconds: defenses can see them, and lit warriors take extra damage. Once it has lit someone, the line itself is no longer hidden.
progression.buildingCatalog.rain_barrel_: Douses fire and rinses venom: burning and poison on buildings within 2.5 tiles end after 1 second, and firebomb splash there is 25% smaller. Wet ground conducts lightning, though.
progression.buildingCatalog.listening_ja: Buried clay jars that amplify every sound underfoot. Diggers within 3 tiles are forced to the surface and stunned for 1 second; unseen walkers within 2 tiles are revealed.
progression.buildingCatalog.living_bambo: A wall that grows back 3% of its health every second and is too springy to climb. Wall-breaking multipliers count half (a 4x ram hits for 2.5x).
progression.buildingCatalog.clockwork_re: A mechanic's crane that reaches over nearby defenses: jams, stuns and a Hawk Tamer's slowing on defenses within 3 tiles are cut short. A few repairs per battle.
progression.buildingCatalog.bitter_incen: Burns bitter herbs: warriors within 3 tiles receive less healing, and healing, haste and toughness auras and shelter shields work at reduced strength on them.
progression.buildingCatalog.straw_scarec: Animals cannot resist it, and birds are terrified of it. Beasts, their companions and charging mounts within 3 tiles must attack it first, and crane gliders swerve away from it. Lots of health, no damage, very flammable.
progression.buildingCatalog.mirror_scree: Polished bronze panels: every third projectile that hits the screen flies back at whoever threw it. Melee warriors just walk up and smash it.
progression.buildingCatalog.sand_bucket_: A bucket crew that smothers explosions and embers: splash damage within 3 tiles is 30% smaller, and they defuse up to two planted charges per battle.
progression.buildingCatalog.kite_cutter_: Air only. Fires a spinning bolas that tangles anything with wings or strings: a flyer it hits is grounded for 3 seconds, where ground defenses can reach it. A flyer that breaks free can't be tangled again for 3 seconds.
progression.buildingCatalog.discipline_b: A clan banner that keeps nearby defenders focused: defenses within 3 tiles ignore taunting bells and decoys.
progression.buildingCatalog.spotter_perc: A lookout who calls targets: defenses within 3 tiles retarget instantly onto warriors that dash, swing or shadow-step into range.
progression.buildingCatalog.steam_vent.d: Blasts scalding steam in a 2-tile circle. It needs no target, so it hurts hidden warriors, blows smoke away from its tiles, and cannot be dodged.
progression.buildingCatalog.sleep_dart_t: Darts that barely scratch but put a warrior to sleep for 2 seconds. The same warrior can only be put to sleep once. Best against a few big fighters.
progression.buildingCatalog.rolling_log_: Releases a log down a 1-tile lane: heavy damage to every ground warrior in the line. It is not splash, so tower shields do not stop it. Punishes clumped buff squads.
progression.buildingCatalog.moonlit_grav: Raked gravel that crunches: anything that teleports, lands or rushes onto it is stunned for 1.5 seconds.
progression.buildingCatalog.ink_seal_pos: Warriors who fall within 3 tiles are sealed in ink: they cannot be revived, and nothing bails out of them.
progression.buildingCatalog.longbow_yagu: A tall archery tower with range 13 that outranges every siege warrior. It prefers warriors attacking from 3.5 tiles or more (throwers and artillery), but cannot hit anything closer than 2 tiles.
progression.buildingCatalog.lightning_ro: Grounds lightning: chained slashes and lightning strikes within 3 tiles hit the rod instead, charging it. When fully charged it fires the lightning back.

roster.warriors.blowgun_hunter.ability.t: Darts keep damaging a building for 5 seconds.
roster.warriors.chain_sickle_reaper.name: Chain-Sickle Reaper
roster.warriors.chain_sickle_reaper.abil: Hits make the target take 20% more damage from everyone.

roster.warriors.iron_monk.ability.name: Iron Skin
roster.warriors.iron_monk.ability.text: Warriors beside him take 15% less damage.

roster.warriors.bell_warden.ability.name: Alarm Bell
roster.warriors.bell_warden.ability.text: Rings a bell that makes defenses in range target him first.

roster.warriors.oni_breaker.name: Oni Breaker
roster.warriors.oni_breaker.ability.name: Oni Smash
roster.warriors.oni_breaker.ability.text: Huge health; smashes walls for five times damage.
roster.warriors.saboteur.name: Saboteur
roster.warriors.saboteur.ability.name: Sabotage

roster.warriors.trap_breaker.name: Trap Breaker
roster.warriors.trap_breaker.ability.tex: Finds and disarms hidden traps along the squad's path.
roster.warriors.gearbreaker.name: Gearbreaker
roster.warriors.gearbreaker.ability.name: Long Jam

roster.warriors.fuse_master.ability.name: Delayed Charge

roster.warriors.mole_king.name: Burrow Ambusher
roster.warriors.mole_king.ability.name: Surface Stun

roster.warriors.crane_glider.ability.tex: Very fast flyer that raids storehouses.

Slow balloon that drops burning embers in a wide area.

trials.modifiers.elite.description: Defenses are 20% tougher and hit 20% harder.
troops.hedgehog_roller.name: Shinobi
troops.hedgehog_roller.description: Fast, cheap melee fighter. Dashes to the nearest building.
troops.frog_lobber.name: Kunai Adept
troops.frog_lobber.description: Throws kunai from a distance. Fragile, so keep it behind sturdier warriors.
troops.beetle_brute.name: Armored Guardian
troops.beetle_brute.description: A heavily armored frontliner who marches straight for defenses and soaks up their fire.
troops.owl_bomber.name: Kite Raider
troops.owl_bomber.description: Glides over walls on a war kite and drops firebombs on defenses. Sky Bow Towers and Shuriken Towers can hit it.
troops.mole_digger.name: Tunnel Runner
troops.mole_digger.description: Digs under walls to reach any building.
troops.saboteur.name: Saboteur
troops.saboteur.description: Grapples over walls to the nearest working defense and jams it for 6 seconds. One jam per Saboteur; afterwards it fights weakly. A jammed defense can't be jammed again until 10 seconds after it recovers.
troops.twin_fang_dancer.name: Twin-Fang Dancer
troops.twin_fang_dancer.description: Every hit lands twice, on its target and the next building beside it.
troops.wind_step_assassin.name: Wind-Step Assassin
troops.wind_step_assassin.description: Dashes to a new target; the first hit after each dash deals double damage.
troops.moonblade_master.name: Moonblade Master
troops.moonblade_master.description: Every fourth strike is a crescent slash for 2.5x damage.
troops.storm_sovereign.name: Storm Sovereign
troops.storm_sovereign.description: Slashes arc between up to three nearby buildings.
troops.shuriken_storm.name: Shuriken Storm
troops.shuriken_storm.description: Throws three shuriken at once; small splash.
troops.blowgun_hunter.name: Blowgun Hunter
troops.blowgun_hunter.description: Darts keep damaging a building for 5 seconds.
troops.chain_sickle_reaper.name: Chain-Sickle Reaper
troops.chain_sickle_reaper.description: Hits make the target take 20% more damage from everyone.
troops.thousand_needle.name: Thousand Needle
troops.thousand_needle.description: Long range (5 tiles) and rapid fire; must stay behind cover.
troops.iron_monk.name: Iron Monk
troops.iron_monk.description: Warriors beside him take 15% less damage.
troops.bell_warden.name: Bell Warden
troops.bell_warden.description: Rings a bell that makes defenses in range target him first.
troops.mountain_shield.name: Mountain Shield
troops.mountain_shield.description: Carries a tower shield that absorbs splash for allies behind him.
troops.oni_breaker.name: Oni Breaker
troops.oni_breaker.description: Huge health; smashes walls for five times damage.
troops.trap_breaker.name: Trap Breaker
troops.trap_breaker.description: Finds and disarms hidden traps along the squad's path.
troops.gearbreaker.name: Gearbreaker
troops.gearbreaker.description: Two jams per warrior, each lasting 9 seconds.
troops.fuse_master.name: Fuse Master
troops.fuse_master.description: Plants a charge on a defense that explodes after 5 seconds.
troops.ghost_engineer.name: Ghost Engineer
troops.ghost_engineer.description: Once per battle, jams up to three defenses within 3 tiles for 4 seconds. Shares jam immunity with other specialists.
troops.wall_climber.name: Wall Climber
troops.wall_climber.description: Climbs over walls and goes for storehouses first.
troops.grapple_raider.name: Grapple Raider
troops.grapple_raider.description: Swings over walls straight to the nearest defense.
troops.mole_king.name: Burrow Ambusher
troops.mole_king.description: Bursts out of the ground beside a defense, stunning it for 2 seconds.
troops.phantom_gate.name: Wall Phantom
troops.phantom_gate.description: Walls near it crumble, opening a path for everyone.
troops.crane_glider.name: Crane Glider
troops.crane_glider.description: Very fast flyer that raids storehouses.
troops.lantern_balloon.name: Lantern Balloon
troops.lantern_balloon.description: Slow balloon that drops burning embers in a wide area.
troops.thunder_kite.name: Thunder Kite
troops.thunder_kite.description: Lightning hits a defense and up to three nearby defenses for 35% damage each.
troops.dragon_kite_armada.name: Dragon Kite Crew
troops.dragon_kite_armada.description: A heavy dragon kite carrying a crew of bombers.
troops.herbalist.name: Herbalist
troops.drum_monk.name: Drum Monk
troops.drum_monk.description: Nearby warriors move and attack 25% faster within 3 tiles. Multiple drums do not stack.
troops.mist_weaver.name: Mist Weaver
troops.mist_weaver.description: Wraps nearby warriors in thin mist (a small moving smoke cloud).
troops.spirit_caller.name: Spirit Caller
troops.spirit_caller.description: Brings one fallen warrior back to its feet.
troops.sage_of_clouds.name: Sage of Clouds
troops.sage_of_clouds.description: Once per battle, heals nearby warriors for 25% and grants a 4-second, one-hit shield (blocks up to half their maximum health). Shields cannot be refreshed for 10 seconds.
troops.ram_crew.name: Ram Crew
troops.ram_crew.description: Four times damage against walls and gates.
troops.fire_monk.name: Fire Monk
troops.fire_monk.description: Short-range fire that burns a small area of buildings.
troops.bomb_carrier.name: Bomb Carrier
troops.bomb_carrier.description: Runs to the nearest wall or defense and explodes.
troops.siege_bombardier.name: Siege Bombardier
troops.siege_bombardier.description: Artillery with 5-tile range that fires on defenses. Stops to fire every 2.5 seconds; still inside a Cannon's reach, and a Longbow Yagura hunts it.
troops.volcano_cannoneer.name: Volcano Cannoneer
troops.volcano_cannoneer.description: Huge splash that leaves burning ground.
troops.hound_handler.name: Hound Handler
troops.hound_handler.description: Fights alongside two hunting dogs. The handler and dogs share one health and damage budget.
troops.hawk_tamer.name: Hawk Tamer
troops.hawk_tamer.description: Her hawk harries a defense from range, slowing its fire.
troops.boar_rider.name: Boar Rider
troops.boar_rider.description: Charges through the first wall in its way.
troops.bear_warrior.name: Bear Warrior
troops.bear_warrior.description: Hits much harder below half health.
troops.tiger_lord.name: Tiger Lord
troops.tiger_lord.description: Arrives with two war tigers. Rider and tigers share one health and damage budget.
troops.shadow_stalker.name: Shadow Stalker
troops.shadow_stalker.description: Cannot be targeted until it attacks for the first time.
troops.mirage_twin.name: Mirage Twin
troops.mirage_twin.description: Leaves a decoy that draws fire for 4 seconds.
troops.night_blade.name: Night Blade
troops.night_blade.description: Deals double damage to buildings inside smoke.
troops.void_walker.name: Void Walker
troops.void_walker.description: Steps through shadows straight onto its target.
troops.eclipse_ninja.name: Eclipse Ninja
troops.eclipse_ninja.description: Unseen until its first attack, immune to traps, and has a 25% chance of double damage on each hit.
